# Sun Optics — full reference

Sun Optics is a luxury eyewear house in India (sunoptics.in). Tagline: "See the world in a new light."

## Signature collection (prices in INR, incl. GST)
| Product | Type | Material | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aurelia Aviator | Sunglasses | β-titanium, polarised G-15 lenses, double bridge | ₹24,900 |
| Monaco Square | Sunglasses | Mazzucchelli acetate, gold-inlaid temple | ₹18,500 |
| Kyoto Round | Optical frame | Japanese titanium, 12 g | ₹29,800 |
| Savoy Cat-Eye | Sunglasses | Layered tortoise acetate | ₹21,400 |
| Meridian Navigator | Sunglasses | Pilot-inspired, ocean-mirror lenses | ₹26,900 |
| Solstice Shield | Sunglasses | Wraparound, 24k gold-tone titanium trim; limited to 250 pieces | ₹32,500 |

## Craft
- Frame: single-block acetate or forged β-titanium, tumbled 72 hours, 24-step hand polish, under 28 g, hypoallergenic and nickel-free.
- Temple: flex core wire, 8° splay, anti-slip acetate tips, free lifetime adjustment in boutique.
- Hinge: 5-barrel spring hinge in gold-plated steel, tested to 20,000 cycles.

## Lenses
100% UVA/UVB protection. Options: polarised, mirror, photochromic, prescription (single-vision, progressive). Coatings: anti-reflective, oleophobic, scratch-resistant. Tints: Bronze (warm contrast, driving), G-15 Green (true colour, low glare), Ocean Mirror (blue flash, water/snow), Rosé Gradient (soft, city), Smoke Grey (neutral, photography).

## Boutiques
New Delhi (Khan Market), Mumbai (Bandra West), Bengaluru (Indiranagar). Open daily 11am–9pm. Services: free eye test, 3D face scan, same-day adjustments, virtual fitting for other cities.

## FAQ
Q: How do I order? A: There is no online checkout. Open a product and tap Enquire on WhatsApp; a stylist confirms availability, prescription options and delivery.
Q: What makes Sun Optics frames different? A: Hand-polished β-titanium or Mazzucchelli acetate, 24-step finish, optical-grade lenses with UV400 protection.
Q: Prescription sunglasses? A: Yes — single-vision, progressive or photochromic after a free eye consultation.
Q: Polarised and UV protected? A: All sunglass lenses block 100% UVA/UVB; polarised, mirror and photochromic available.
Q: Warranty and returns? A: 2-year warranty; 14-day return on unworn non-prescription pieces.
Q: Delivery across India? A: Yes, insured shipping across India.

Contact: hello@sunoptics.in
